alerts.innerHTML:
Flood Watch

Flood Watch issued April 14 at 5:12AM EDT until April 16 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Albany NY

Details
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall and snowmelt is possible.

* WHERE...Portions of southern Vermont, including Windham County.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers, creeks and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared to take action should flooding develop.
Wind Advisory

Wind Advisory issued April 14 at 5:12AM EDT until April 16 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Albany NY

Details
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 40 mph expected.

* WHERE...Windham County.

Winds this strong can blow around unsecured objects. Boats on open water should secure moorings.
